title: Editing Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: After a root certificate is added to your organization for Zero Trust Browser, you can edit it at any time, even while it's associated with an isolation profile. The only certificate you cannot fully edit is the default Zscaler Root Certificate. To learn more, see About Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Internet & SaaS.
You cannot change the PEM file in a root certificate. To use a different PEM file, you must add a new root certificate.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Root Certificates.
Click the Edit icon for the certificate.
The Edit Root Certificate drawer opens.
In the Edit Root Certificate drawer:
Edit the Name for the root certificate.
Edit the Type of the root certificate. Use the drop-down menu to add or remove the selected type(s).
